scope.zh: 文献级范式字段单独核验；不将整套 benchmark 的标签自动传给每个子游戏或任务。
scope.en: This is a paper-level field review. Suite-level labels do not automatically propagate to every game or task.

LLM.zh: 来源明确的语言模型智能体、推理模型或语言智能体接口。
LLM.en: Explicit language-model agents, reasoners or language-agent interfaces.

VLM.zh: 模型在相关角色中使用视觉观测与语言；仅视觉游戏画面或视觉评分裁判不足。
VLM.en: Models use visual observations and language in a relevant role; a visual game or judge-only use is insufficient.

VLA.zh: 整合视觉与语言条件并预测可执行动作的策略；VLM 外接工具不自动满足。
VLA.en: An integrated policy conditions on vision and language to predict executable actions; a VLM with external tools does not automatically qualify.

IL.zh: 来源明确的示范模仿、行为克隆或模仿评测；仅提供人类数据或一般监督分类不够。
IL.en: Explicit demonstration imitation, behavioral cloning or imitation evaluation; a human dataset or generic supervised classification is insufficient.

RL.zh: 实际训练或评测的强化学习策略、对比基线，或明确为 RL 设计的接口；仅数据采集和相关文献不够。
RL.en: Trained/evaluated reinforcement-learning policies, actual baselines or explicitly RL-designed interfaces; collection-only or cited-only use is insufficient.

confirmed.zh: 至少一个标签有直接原始来源依据，不代表全部兼容性已穷尽。
confirmed.en: At least one label has direct primary-source evidence; compatibility is not exhaustive.

pending.zh: 来源或具体模型 / 训练方法证据不足，列出尚缺信息。
pending.en: Source or specific model/training evidence is insufficient; missing information is listed.

not_applicable.zh: 研究对象不适用于这五类字段，如纯综述、视频生成器或专用经典 / 神经符号求解器；不等于没有研究价值或没有任务。
not_applicable.en: The object falls outside these five fields, e.g. a survey, video generator or dedicated classical/neurosymbolic solver; this does not imply lack of research value or tasks.

counting.zh: 标签非互斥，按文献去重；筛选数量随其他条件变化。核验状态与任务协议、可运行性和能力证据分别记录。
counting.en: Labels are non-exclusive and deduplicated by paper. Facet counts follow other filters. Field review, task protocols, runtime availability and capability evidence remain separate.
